race.comment: FIGHT FOR VICTORY (2) was in the money at this track two runs ago before having his colours lowered at his latest appearance over 2138m here, beaten 19 metres. Has the benefit of a good draw. It doesn't get any easier but on his best form he is capable of a far better performance. OPALLANE (8) ran eighth last start at this circuit over 1660m, beaten 13 metres. Has ability and should be right in the finish. SAINT MAHARG (13) has to come into calculations on the back of some strong recent form, most recently when fifth at this venue over 2138m. Must be included. KASH FUND (10) is also in contention although the draw makes his job a bit tougher. May earn some minor money.
